title: Associate Professor of Biomedical Informatics
bio: 10 Shattuck Street #303, Boston, MA 02115 Research Publications Assistant Michael Baym received his PhD in Mathematics from MIT and was a postdoctoral fellow at Harvard Medical School in Systems Biology. Baym's research is centered around the problem of antibiotic resistance, at the intersection of experimental, theoretical and computational techniques. His work ranges from understanding the basic mechanisms of evolution to the development of algorithms for computation on massive biological datasets. Computational Omics
research_interests: Computational Omics Evolutionary Genetics Microbial Genomics
